name: Open the camera from a link while camera access is blocked
description: With camera access turned off, a link that opens the app's camera screen lands on a clear 'Camera permission required' message instead of a broken camera view. Asking to grant access shows a notice pointing to Settings, and nothing crashes or dead-ends.
details: Camera TCC revoked, then an OS-level sovran://camera deep link on the warm app: expo-router must land on the camera route, which shows its in-screen 'Camera permission required' empty state instead of a broken viewfinder. Grant access on the blocked record surfaces the camera-permission blocked toast (with its Open-settings action) rather than a system prompt, and the route stays on the same empty state — no crash, no dead-end. Exit home, wallet untouched. Complements wallet.scan.camera-permission (which proves the wallet-side gate never navigates) by proving the camera route's own denied-state UX when entered directly. This scenario originally EXPOSED two defects: the Grant access label rendered white-on-white, and the old action-menu feedback presented invisibly behind the pushed camera route.
